description_en: Queries the logs of an instance
kebab_example: aliyun searchengine list-logs --instance-id ha-cn-i7m2roiy504 --type push --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --start-time 1706340600 --end-time 1710432000 --query status:_200_AND_totalTime_0.01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLogs

parameters.description_en: The log type. Valid values: \`select\` (query logs) and \`push\` (write logs).
parameters.description_zh: select: 查询日志, push: 写入日志
